current_activity: first combat: crosses the Meurthe toward Raon-l'Étape
notes: Event date: 12 November 1944 (Riviera p387: Brooks directed the 100th Division on 12 November to proceed immediately across the Meurthe against Raon-l'Étape; p391: the 100th and 103d Divisions were "entering combat for the first time"). Event definition: the 100th Division, just landed at Marseille (atlas 20 October), starts the VI Corps' preliminary attacks; the date is the order to cross, and the first contact may be a day or two later. Relationship: VI Corps, Seventh Army and 6th Army Group (CMH table, from 1 November). Location: Division command post at Sainte-Barbe on 11 November (atlas), the day before; Baccarat on 14 November. Coordinates: Wikipedia (fr): Baccarat. Event support: moderate (an order date; actual first contact not dated in the page read). Location support: moderate (command post listed one day earlier).

current_activity: command post in Stuttgart after General Devers told the division to move into the city
notes: Event date: 27 April 1945 (CMH ETO-OB command-post list of the 100th Infantry Division: Stuttgart on 27 Apr 45; Last Offensive ch. 18 p. 432: after reporting the matter to General Eisenhower on 26 April, Devers reiterated his order to relinquish the city and told the 100th Division to move in; p. 432: the French had captured the city, Devers decided on 22 April to place it in the American zone effective the next day, and General Devers himself went into Stuttgart on the 27th). Event definition: the division command post is in the city on the day after the order; the row records the position of the headquarters. Relationship: Seventh Army assigned (from 1 Nov 44, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 25 Apr 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The earlier assigned relation to 6th Army Group (CR0354) is closed at 24 April 1945 (inferred_from_next_claim); see the Review note on it. The earlier unspecified_subordination relation to VI Corps (CR0356) is closed at 24 April 1945 (inferred_from_next_claim); see the Review note on it. Location: Stuttgart (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R335 p. 378: listed 27 April 1945); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Stuttgart. Event support: moderate (one Green Book chapter and the CMH table). Location support: moderate (command post listed on the date). Review (26 October 2026, found while adding this row): the CMH table lists the 12th Army Group as the division's army group from 25 April 1945, but the Green Book (p. 432) shows General Devers, the 6th Army Group commander, ordering the division into Stuttgart on 26 April; the relation to the 12th Army Group is recorded as the table has it (option C start 25 April) and the conflict with the narrative is not resolved here. Review (27 October 2026, decided by Scott; no value changed): Scott approved keeping the division's parent from 25 April 1945 as the Seventh Army (CR0355, which the CMH table lists; the table lists no corps from that date) and the 12th Army Group relation as the table has it; old value and new value are the same, and the conflict with the Green Book narrative stays annotated.
